#!/bin/bash
set -e
keyword="${1:-alpha}"
rm -rf experiment

EOT

${keyword} is present now.
End of log.
EOT
cat > experiment/set2/deep/info.txt <<EOT
This file does not match.
Still no target word.
EOT
printf 'ignore me\n' > experiment/set2/deep/skip.md
EOF

cat > count_keyword_lines.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
keyword="$1"
[ -n "$keyword" ] || { echo "Usage: $0 <keyword>" >&2; exit 1; }
find experiment -type f -name '*.txt' -print0 |
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  if grep -qF -- "$keyword" "$file"; then
    wc -l < "$file"
  fi
done | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s+0}'
EOF

chmod +x generate_experiment.sh count_keyword_lines.sh
./generate_experiment.sh alpha
./count_keyword_lines.sh alpha"}
